column1: # Per-seed gap report on the variance_mitigation suite (real
# measurement, K=8, 5 seeds). Negative gap_zvf means AERO has
# LOWER mean ZVF than GRPO (better contrast). Three row kinds:
#   per_seed  -- one row per seed index for full traceability
#   summary   -- across-seed mean gap with paired bootstrap CI
#   bin_*     -- quantile-bin stratification; reports bin label,
#                 n_pairs in bin, mean gap (NOT bootstrap CI
#                 because n_pairs<=5 makes CI degenerately tight)
